---
name: ship-notes
description: >
  Draft a clear release notes summary from git commits and pull requests.
  Use when the user asks for changelog text, release notes, or a shipping summary.
---

# Ship notes

1. Collect merged pull requests or conventional commits for the range the user named.
2. Group changes into Added, Changed, Fixed, and Removed.
3. Write short, user-facing bullets. Omit chore and typo-only commits unless asked.
4. Offer a one-paragraph highlight at the top when the release has a theme.
